## Safety and maintenance
- [ ] Active source/approved docs only; frozen references, public identities and saved state preserved
- [ ] No needless duplicate systems, refactors or installation paths
- [ ] Runtime temporary helpers tagged/registered; standalone test probes tagged; all disposable helpers removed on acceptance
- [ ] New release candidate only: explicit `--release-gate` plus owner approval

## Evidence and handoff
- Observed checks (SOURCE REVIEW / OFFLINE PASS / RUNTIME OBSERVED / INTEGRATION ACCEPTED):
- Limitations, affected contracts and remaining debt:
- Current state/roadmap and applicable records updated (or not applicable):
- Next bounded action:

A checked box is a declaration, not proof. Do not create records for unaffected areas.
